description: Explicitly human-chosen toy axes and calibration surfaces. This is a diagnostic test space, not an approved production contract.

dimensions.definition: Who has permission to authorize an action
phrases: The actor has delegated authorization
An authorized signer approves the request
Permission is explicitly granted
The responsible officer has issued consent

dimensions.definition: A binding duty or enforceable commitment
phrases: A party has an enforceable duty
A required commitment remains outstanding
The agreement imposes a binding obligation
Someone is required to perform

dimensions.definition: Use, ownership, or allocation of scarce resources
phrases: The transaction allocates limited compute
A scarce asset is being transferred
The work consumes budgeted resources
The parties assign resource ownership

dimensions.definition: Observations or proofs supporting a claim
phrases: The claim requires an audit trail
Recorded observations serve as evidence
A verifiable proof accompanies the request
The proposal depends on documented facts

dimensions.definition: Temporal order, deadline, duration, or validity window
phrases: The action must occur before a deadline
The permission expires at a fixed time
The sequence has a time constraint
The agreement specifies an execution window
The outcome is not yet known
Several interpretations remain possible
The evidence leaves uncertainty unresolved
The decision depends on a probability estimate

dimensions.definition: A prohibition, incompatibility, or disallowed overlap
phrases: The two actions cannot be combined
The contract forbids this operation
The requested state is explicitly excluded
The conditions are mutually incompatible

dimensions.definition: Changes in a state caused by an action
phrases: The action changes the resulting state
The contract specifies a downstream effect
A transition follows the operation
The decision has an enforceable consequence
